description:
WHAT: Query the public OSV.dev database (api.osv.dev querybatch) directly from your machine for exact package versions; returns which are vulnerable and the advisory IDs.
WHEN: Quick "is lodash 4.17.20 vulnerable?" checks for up to 200 packages; then osv_get_vulnerability for details of specific IDs.
WHEN NOT: Parsing manifests/lockfiles, severity filtering, fixed/recommended versions in one shot -> osv_audit_dependencies (paid).
COST: Free; no token, nothing sent to Fairquery or Apify.
RETURNS: Paged "package" rows (vulnerable, vuln_ids) or per-entry INVALID_ECOSYSTEM "error" rows. Tool errors: OSV_FETCH_FAILED (retryable).
BEHAVIOR: One HTTPS request to api.osv.dev (Google-run public API) for all packages; typically <2 s, 20 s timeout. Results change only when OSV publishes advisories.
PARAMETERS: packages: each entry is checked independently and returns exactly one row, in input order. An unknown ecosystem yields a per-entry INVALID_ECOSYSTEM error row while the other entries still run. A version range such as "^4.17.0" or ">=2" is not resolved and normally returns no vulnerabilities (a false "safe"), so pin versions from your lockfile first. Duplicate entries are queried and returned twice. limit/offset page the rows (all packages are sent to OSV in a single request); meta.vulnerable_count counts all packages, not only the page.
EXAMPLE: {"packages":[{"ecosystem":"npm","name":"lodash","version":"4.17.20"}]} -> vulnerable true, vuln_ids ["GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm",...].

limit.description: Optional page size: items to return, integer 1-200 (default 100). Example: 50

offset.description: Optional zero-based number of items to skip, integer 0-1000000 (default 0); pass nextOffset from the previous response, e.g. 100

packages.description: Required. 1-200 {ecosystem, name, version} objects, one exact version each. Example: [{"ecosystem":"npm","name":"lodash","version":"4.17.20"},{"ecosystem":"PyPI","name":"django","version":"3.2.0"}]

ecosystem.description: Required, 1-40 chars, case-insensitive. One of npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, crates.io, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist, Pub, Hex; aliases node, pip, python, golang, java, cargo, rust, gem, ruby, composer accepted. Example: "npm"

name.description: Required, 1-300 chars. Package name exactly as published: npm "lodash" or "@scope/pkg", PyPI "django", Go module path "github.com/gin-gonic/gin", Maven "groupId:artifactId" e.g. "org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core"

version.description: Required, 1-100 chars. One exact version without range operators or "v" prefix, e.g. "4.17.20" (not "^4.17.0"); Go uses "v1.9.0"

name: osv_query_packages

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

title: Check package versions for known vulnerabilities (free, OSV.dev)
